description: This header file defines the dmUtility class which provides static utility functions for string manipulation, query parsing, and property handling used in the project.

classes.name: dmUtility
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for string and property manipulations.

methods.name: void splitQuery(char const * query,char * parameter)
methods.description: Extracts the parameter from a query string by finding the last occurrence of '.' or '\' and appending the substring after it to the given parameter buffer.

methods.name: bool has_suffix(const std::string & str,const std::string & suffix)
methods.description: Checks whether a given string ends with the specified suffix.

methods.name: bool isWildcard(char const * s)
methods.description: Determines if the input C-string ends with a '.' character.

methods.name: std::string trimWildcard(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes the trailing '.' from a string if it exists.

methods.name: std::string trimProperty(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes the property suffix after the last '.' from a string.

methods.name: std::string trimPropertyName(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Extracts the property name (substring after the last '.') from a string.

methods.name: std::string trimSetProperty(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes the property assignment part from a string, especially handling multi-set formats with braces.

methods.name: bool parseMultisetValue(std::string const & s,std::vector<std::pair<std::string,std::string>> & nameVals)
methods.description: Parses a string representing multiple key-value pairs enclosed in braces into a vector of pairs.

methods.name: void splitString(std::string const & s,char delim,std::vector<std::string> & out)
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on a specified delimiter, storing the tokens in an output vector.
